description: Source code for the IgnitableComponent class, managing fire behavior (ignition, extinguishing, damage, spreading) in the Unvanquished game.

classes.name: IgnitableComponent
classes.description: Component handling fire ignition, damage, spread, and extinguish logic for game entities.

methods.name: HandlePrepareNetCode
methods.description: Prepares network state flags based on whether the entity is on fire.

methods.name: HandleIgnite
methods.description: Handles ignition logic, including setting fire starter, spread timing, and re-ignition.

methods.name: HandleExtinguish
methods.description: Handles extinguishing fire and setting immunity period.

methods.name: DamageSelf
methods.description: Applies damage to the entity itself if on fire.

methods.name: DamageArea
methods.description: Applies splash damage around the entity if on fire.

methods.name: ConsiderStop
methods.description: Decides whether to stop burning based on burn time and proximity to other fires.

methods.name: ConsiderSpread
methods.description: Attempts to spread fire to nearby entities if conditions are met.
